content.text: {"headline":"Approve P1, the no-cost rebalance: predicted 88.1% service level for 11:45–20:00, above the 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"General calls have run 28–51% above forecast since 10:15, with no explanation in the feeds. P1 delays the 12:15–12:45 breaks on both queues by 45 minutes. It moves 3 cross-skilled agents from payments to general for 15:00–16:00 and 1 agent for 18:00–19:00. It also turns on IVR callback on general for 15:00–16:00 and 18:00–20:00. That lifts general to 83.8% and keeps payments at 92.6%, with predicted abandons of 2.7%. It is the cheapest plan that meets policy and the target. Note that doing nothing (P0) is also predicted to reach 86.5%, but general would sit only just over target at 80.6%. P1 adds margin there for no cost.","trade_offs":["P0 (no action) costs nothing and is predicted to reach 86.5% overall, but general would be at 80.6%, leaving almost no buffer if the surge grows.","P2 (chat deflection) costs ₹930 and lifts general to 85.2% (89.0% overall). This is a small gain over P1.","P4 costs ₹3,810 and P3 costs ₹7,290. They give the strongest general recovery, at 88.4% and 91.3%, and the lowest abandons, at 2.1% and 1.9%. That is extra cost the target doesn't require.","Moving agents off payments has little effect there: payments is predicted at 92.6% under P1 versus 92.7% with no action."],"watch":"The cause of the surge is unknown. Login_issue (1.65x normal) and balance_enquiry (1.5x) are elevated, so check with IT for an unreported login or app problem. If general volume climbs further or general service level drops toward 80%, step up to P2 or P4."}
